system.summary: A 4-figure table with literal phrase repeats, so no additive on it: first pair in 01-09, 10-13, 15, or round 20-90; second in 01-31 or round 40-90. No value of any group is known. Larger 4- and 5-figure traffic in the same file is unread too.

prior_solution.where: GC&CS read other Soviet links in 1921 (Tiltman); HW 12 and RG 457 6707N not seen; no reading of these messages found

tools: shared language engine with a Russian corpus from ru.wikipedia

solution.what: Fetched the OCR of the nine M316 reels with research/nara_reels/reels.py and viewed the covering despatch 861.00/8575 (frames 041-0871, 0872).

Tiltman, Experiences 1920-1939: Soviet dinome tables under transposition, discriminant DELEGAT, read by GC&CS from April 1921 on the London link. Web searches found no reading of this traffic and nothing on the Murashenko method.

Segmented 625 frames into 1,478 runs, 66,640 groups (OCR): counters every 25 groups, discriminant words, Austrian 0-19999 traffic, plain repeats on the Angora and Christiania runs, raised dinome IC on many 5-figure runs.
First pair and second pair as chained consonant + vowel tables, annealed against Russian, with shuffled controls.
Mutual information between neighbouring pairs against shuffles: strong inside a group, none or weak from second pair to next first pair (Karakhan z 0.0, Kopp/Lutovinov z 2.2).
Second-pair stream as monoalphabetic Russian: -3.69 per character against -3.69 for the shuffled control and -2.11 for real text.
Aligned dinomes of the 5-figure runs: contact test and swap anneal to Russian; no Russian came out.

Clustered 4-figure messages as the small table code plus a periodic numerical key (Nr 461). Periods 14 and 2 scored above shuffles, but 14 is the typed line length, only 9-15% of stripped groups fall in the known vocabulary, and no single odd-even difference stands out.
Columnar widths 5-36 in both read directions, double columnar up to 5 x 5, with synthetic tests and shuffled controls; no text.
Lenin PSS 52 no. 314 (7 May 1921, in cipher to Kopp) compared with Moscow messages of that date: no fit shown. DVP IV crawl stopped after 22 pages when the site refused this machine.
The shared indicator 01135 as a shared key: the key from Nr 1883 applied to the other 01135 message at every gap from 0 to 120 scored -4.97, barely above random keys (best -5.07).
Scanned English corpora and two George Wither texts for a window matching the recovered key rank pattern: best 10/24, chance level; key source not found.
Small figure table as one letter per group under the corrected model: same score as shuffled text (-2.43 to -2.50 against -2.40 to -2.54); collapses into repeated letters.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only attempts gave no group value; every hypothesis failed its control and no code book or plaintext was found.
outcome.notes: Blocked on a code book, a matching plaintext or the HW 12 / RG 457 papers. The letter traffic in the same file is split off by key: lejava1921, voikov1921, voikov1921b, stomoniakov1921; karakhan1921 is a different table.
